title: calibration-fingerprint-and-replayable-quant-artifacts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Establish a deterministic, auditable fingerprinting and replayable calibration pipeline for quantization artifacts (FP8/INT8). Deliver a compact artifact bundle format (metadata + tensors + signature) and CI/validation harness that guarantees a calibration run can be re-executed to produce the same quant outputs and that any deployed quant artifact can be traced back to the exact inputs and environment used to produce it.
acceptance_criteria: Define and document a stable fingerprint schema that includes: base model commit hash, model config (arch + hyperparams), calibration dataset hash, random seeds, toolchain version (compiler/kernels), quant parameters (per-layer scale/zero points or FP8 recipe), and Docker image digest.
Implement a CLI that emits a signed artifact bundle (.qbundle) containing: quant tensors, metadata.json (flat key/value), build.log, and an SHA-256 fingerprint recorded in metadata.

Re-execution reproducibility: running 'rbundle replay' in the recorded container image with recorded seeds and calibration input must produce an artifact whose fingerprint matches the original (bitwise identical or deterministic checksum match) for at least 95% of validation candidates across a representative prompt set.
CI gates: PRs that change calibration logic must fail if the fingerprint of a golden calibration changes beyond documented tolerance and must attach an artifact diff report.
Ability to map any deployed artifact to its originating qbundle and to perform an automated rollback to the previous artifact when accuracy regression > 0.5% on golden prompts is detected.
Security: artifact bundles must be signed with the build service key and signature verification must be integrated into the deployment path for Dedicated/Private deployments.
Operational: Console shows artifact fingerprint, creation date, creator, validation metrics, and a link to the qbundle in internal storage.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (design): finalize fingerprint schema and qbundle layout; design metadata keys as flat strings; review with applied-ml and infra teams.
Phase 2 (tools): implement qbundle builder and signer in calibration service; add 'replay' mode that runs calibration inside a recorded container image.
Phase 3 (CI): add reproducibility checks and artifact-diff reporter to calibrations CI job; fail on unexpected diffs unless an explicit calibration bump is approved.
Phase 4 (deployment): integrate signature verification into deploy pipelines and expose fingerprints in Console; create simple rollback endpoint in deployment service.
Phase 5 (validation & rollout): run large-scale validation on sample models (gpt-small-ish, llama-7b variants) and iterate on tolerance thresholds and golden prompt sets.
technical_notes: Fingerprint must be computed deterministically: canonicalize metadata keys (alphabetic order), serialize tensors using little-endian fixed layout, strip volatile timestamps from logs before hashing.
We will use SHA-256 for the fingerprint and an additional Ed25519 signature for the bundle; signature keys managed by build CI via KMS and rotated quarterly.
Container immutability: enforce Docker image digest references in metadata and store image manifests in the internal registry for replay runs.

Calibration nondeterminism sources: multithreaded RNG, non-deterministic GPU kernels, MKL/BLAS variations. Mitigations: force single-threaded deterministic RNG path for replay, pin kernel sets where possible, record kernel selection metadata.

Tolerance vs strict bitwise equality: for FP8 runs we expect bitwise reproduction for majority but allow configurable semantic tolerance checks (top-k logit diffs, perplexity delta) as a fallback; CI will flag non-bitwise but semantically-equivalent artifacts.
Bundle format: flat metadata.json with string values only; tensor payloads stored as separate files with stable names (layer_000.weight.bin) and listed in metadata for ordering.
Storage: qbundles live in s3://redwood-quant-artifacts/ with folder by date and fingerprint; metadata indexed in artifact catalog for quick lookup.
API surface: artifact lookup by fingerprint, list artifacts by model+version, download qbundle, replay endpoint that starts a containerized calibration job with recorded inputs.
test_plan: Unit tests for fingerprinting: canonicalization, ordering, and checksum determinism across languages (python/Go) used in pipeline.
Integration: produce qbundles for INT8 and FP8 calibrations across three models and run replay job in CI; compare SHA-256 checksums.
Golden prompt validation: run a 200-prompt eval set; require delta < 0.5% accuracy drop for promoted artifacts; produce diff report when regression observed.
Fuzz testing: intentionally vary non-recorded env vars to verify they do not affect fingerprint; intentionally corrupt qbundle to verify signature verification rejects it.
Load test: ensure artifact catalog and S3 retrieval scales to expected throughput for Dedicated rollout and does not add >50ms to deploy path.
rollback_playbook: Detection: monitoring triggers when validation metrics on production route fall outside thresholds (integration with console/alerts).
Lookup: operator uses fingerprint reported in error to find qbundle and prior good artifact via artifact catalog.
Verification: run replay in isolated environment to confirm artifact mismatch and reproduce regression.
Rollback: call deployment API with previous artifact fingerprint (API verifies signature and image digest) to redeploy last-known-good quant artifact.
Postmortem: create incident notes linking to qbundles, CI diff reports, and kernel/runtime logs; if root cause is toolchain/kernel, open follow-up engineering issue.
Customer communication: standard templated notification for impacted customers with remediation ETA; optional hotfix builds for Dedicated/Private customers if needed.
